environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind a basic Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no additional middleware. TLS terminated at the NLB. No rate limiting configured. Service accessible on port 443 via public internet. Session cookies set without __Host- prefix. SameSite=Lax (Starlette default).

config.cookie_config: SameSite=Lax, no __Host- prefix, Secure not enforced
